reason: Adds a targeted Clone() for content items used to fix cross-thread cache sharing in widget rendering; the new Clone method omits some ContentItem properties (e.g., Weld status, Number, TenantId if any, or other fields not listed) which could subtly affect downstream code relying on full parity with the original item, but the change is localized and low-risk overall.
